content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 1: Python Essentials for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 2: Working with Libraries (pandas, numpy)
    - Lesson 3: Exploring Datasets and Data Cleaning
    - Lesson 4: Aggregating and Manipulating Data
    - Lesson 5: Statistical Analysis in Python
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
    - Lesson 7: Visualizing Data with Seaborn and Plotly
    - Lesson 8: Hypothesis Testing and Confidence Intervals
    - Lesson 9: Regression Analysis in Python
    - Lesson 10: Model Evaluation and Selection

   Track: SQL for Data Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: Using WHERE Clauses
    - Lesson 4: Filtering with JOIN Operators
    - Lesson 5: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 6: Using Subqueries in SQL
    - Lesson 7: Creating Temporary Tables and Views
    - Lesson 8: Advanced Sorting and Limiting Results
    - Lesson 9: Performing Updates and Deletions
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Database Design

   Track: Excel for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Basic Navigation and Data Entry
    - Lesson 2: Using Functions (SUM, AVERAGE)
    - Lesson 3: Working with Formulas and Arrays
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to PivotTables
    - Lesson 5: Advanced Filtering and Sorting
    - Lesson 6: Creating Charts and Visualizing Data
    - Lesson 7: Power Query (Get & Transform)
    - Lesson 8: Working with Excel Macros
    - Lesson 9: Importing/Exporting Data from Databases
    - Lesson 10: Advanced Data Analysis Techniques

   Track: Machine Learning Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Supervised and Unsupervised Learning
    - Lesson 2: Introduction to Scikit-Learn
    - Lesson 3: Training and Evaluating Models
    - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering and Selection
    - Lesson 5: Regression Analysis with Machine Learning
    - Lesson 6: Classification Techniques in ML
    - Lesson 7: Clustering and Anomaly Detection
    - Lesson 8: Ensemble Methods and Model Stacking
    - Lesson 9: Hyperparameter Tuning
    - Lesson 10: Bias, Variance, and Overfitting in ML

   Track: Data Wrangling and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Data Quality Assessment
    - Lesson 2: Handling Missing Values
    - Lesson 3: Transforming Categorical Data
    - Lesson 4: Scaling and Normalization Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Feature Engineering Strategies
    - Lesson 6: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques
    - Lesson 7: Handling Outliers and Anomalies
    - Lesson 8: Time Series Analysis Concepts
    - Lesson 9: Text Data Processing Techniques
    - Lesson 10: Advanced Data Preprocessing Topics

   Track: Business Intelligence and Reporting
    - Lesson 1: Dashboards and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
    - Lesson 2: Building and Designing Reports
    - Lesson 3: Power BI for Data Visualization
    - Lesson 4: Creating Interactive and Mobile Dashboards
    - Lesson 5: Building Data-Driven Stories with Reports
    - Lesson 6: Data Security and Compliance
    - Lesson 7: Scheduling and Automating Reports
    - Lesson 8: Integrating External Data Sources
    - Lesson 9: Collaborative Reporting Techniques
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Delivering Insights to Stakeholders
